Girard spherical excess of the exact angle multisets yields the listed area-law; the edge-separation first moment equals 30 beta/pi. I independently reconstructed 20 vertices and 30 edges and sampled 10,000 Gaussian normal directions; observed only 6,8,10 corners with frequencies agreeing with the exact formula, corroborating but not proving the finite exact classification. Distinction between section corners and chamber sides is correct.
